name: Sjögren's Syndrome
description: Chronic autoimmune disease characterized by lymphocytic infiltration of exocrine glands (salivary and lacrimal) causing severe dryness (sicca), systemic manifestations, and a 15-20× increased risk of B cell lymphoma. Driven by type I IFN signature, B cell hyperactivity, and Tfh-mediated germinal center responses.
primary_tissue: Exocrine glands (salivary, lacrimal); can involve lungs, kidneys, joints, nervous system
hallmark_markers: Positive minor salivary gland biopsy (focus score ≥1)
